instructions: Read the complete rendering policy through read_policy. For each independent artifact case, transform the supplied draft or source into the requested output and persist it through write_output. These are isolated human-facing outputs; preserve their facts and use the supplied source material. Do not query a tracker or read additional files. Separately answer every bounded rule question. Global operator guidance applies. Finish after every case is recorded.

tools.name: read_policy
tools.description: Read the unchanged policy in bounded chunks. Start at offset 0, then use each returned next_offset until it is null. Complete policy delivery is required before workflow operations. No scratch file is needed.

tools.name: write_output
tools.description: Persist the completed rendering for one artifact case. Write once per case; provide the actual normalised text or violation report requested.

tools.name: answer_rule
tools.description: Answer one separate bounded policy question in its stated value shape. Do not perform hypothetical actions.

tools.name: finish
tools.description: Finish after all artifacts and rule answers are recorded.

source.title: Bound import retries

files.src/import.ts: export async function runImport(payload) { return importOnce(payload); }
files.src/errors.ts: export class ImportError extends Error { transient: boolean; }
files.src/logger.ts: export function log(event, fields) { /* existing logger */ }

explore.integration: Existing caller expects successful import value or original terminal error; existing job runner calls runImport.

requirements: Attempt importOnce at most 3 times, including the initial attempt.
Retry only ImportError with transient true, immediately, using the existing job runner; do not introduce backoff.
Success returns the original successful value; permanent errors or the third transient error return the original error.
Log retry attempts using attempt number only. Logs MUST NOT contain payloads.
Add a separate DONE item for the repository test file test/import-retry.test.ts passing.

Use three behavioural scenarios: immediate success, transient failure then success, three transient failures. Withhold the third as one holdout; retain the other two visible. Include the log privacy assertion as a non-functional criterion.

decisions.reason: Preserve caller interface and runner ownership

rule_questions.question: Does a mechanical text-only objective require a behavioural scenario? Return {"required": boolean}.
For a non-trivial behavioural objective choose the canonical machine-readable scenario form. Return {"fenced":boolean,"capitalised_step_starts":boolean,"bulleted_steps":boolean}.
Does a non-functional log privacy objective require forced Given/When/Then? Return {"forced_gwt":boolean}.
Can a holdout introduce the only statement of a new requirement? Return {"allowed":boolean}.
May DONE introduce a requirement absent from the body? Return {"allowed":boolean}.
Should a repository test-file check share a DONE item with HTTP behaviour? Return {"separate_items":boolean}.
A Punt clearly belongs to architecture. Return {"owner_suffix":"architecture"|"omit"}.
Only an eligible non-blocking Punt remains and review has no findings. Return {"confidence":"high"|"medium"|"low"}.
Inherited review retains one blocker. Return {"high_allowed":boolean}.
Where does the spec-readiness contract block go? Return {"position":"last"|"first"}.
